name: aigpu-b1-tile
description: Pre-silicon RTL-verifiable 4-core compute tile slice for aigpu-b1 (1 cluster x 4 cores, RV64 AI-only TFR/WGMMA, graphics disabled; NOT measured physical silicon).

sources.evidence_status: PRE-SILICON RTL-VERIFIABLE COMPUTE TILE SLICE ONLY: 4-core verification target for rtlsim, Beacon, and non-sign-off open-source synthesis per ADR-006; NOT measured physical silicon and NOT full 64-core aigpu-b1 SoC closure.
sources.xlen: 64-bit RV64IMAFD machine (configure --profile=aigpu-b1-tile selects build64 and build32 rejects the profile).
sources.NUM_CLUSTERS, NUM_CORES, SOCKET_SIZE: 1 cluster x 4 cores in a single 4-core socket (RTL-bounded verification slice: NUM_CORES == SOCKET_SIZE = 4).
sources.NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH: 8 warps x 8 threads per core, 2 issue slices (TCU geometry: 4x2x2 block, 8x8x8 WMMA tile, 2 TCU blocks x 8 lanes/core).
sources.LMEM_ENABLE, L2_ENABLE, L2_SIZE: Default 16 KiB shared LMEM (LMEM_LOG_SIZE=14 <= 18 WGMMA limit, 8 banks) plus shared 256 KiB write-back L2 cache (262144 B, 8 ways, 128 B lines => 256 sets).
sources.FPU_TYPE, EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_TYPE, TCU_: Native STD scalar FPU and TFR tensor cores (zero DPI substitution) enabling WGMMA, FP16/BF16, FP8/BF8, FP4/MX/MXFP4/NVFP4, INT8, 2:4 structured sparsity, DXA async DMA, MUFU transcendentals, and RV64A atomics.
sources.EXT_TEX_ENABLE, EXT_RASTER_ENABLE, EXT_O: Explicitly false: graphics/RTU units removed in the AI-only tile slice to match aigpu-b1 pruning.
sources.reference: Modeled analytical baseline from resolved defaults (64 FP32 lanes = 4 cores x 2 issue blocks x 8 FPU lanes; default VX_config.toml platform 400 MHz and 460 GB/s) checked by ci/profile_check.py --metrics=peak. Explicitly NOT measured FPGA or silicon hardware.
